title: Minister Shrestha emphasizes on preparedness to avert possible impacts of El Niño - The Rising Nepal
description: Minister Shrestha emphasizes on preparedness to avert possible impacts of El Niño  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
Kathmandu, Aug 21: Minister for Energy, Water Resources and Irrigation, Biraj Bhakta Shrestha, has highlighted the need to take prompt actions with preparedness in the fields of water, food, irrigation and disaster resilience.

In his address to the inaugural ceremony of the national workshop 'Super El Niño and Climate Risk: Impacts on Water, Food, Energy, and Disaster Resilience' today, he stressed the urgency to take strides keeping potential impacts of Super El Nino into consideration.

The workshop was organized in Lalitpur by the Secretariat of the Water and Energy Commission and the Department of Hydrology and Meteorology.

Minister Shrestha noted that the recent forecasts regarding El Niño indicate an increased likelihood of potential impacts on rainfall, temperature, hydropower production, irrigation, and food production in Nepal so it has to be taken seriously.

“As Kulekhani-1 is only one seasonal reservoir project in the 4,120 MW electricity system currently operational in Nepal, there is therefore a need to increase storage capacity in the energy sector,” the minister stated.

Nepal has made significant progress in energy trade. Although dependence on energy imports increases in dry seasons, so developing reservoir projects and storage capacity is necessary for energy security, he argued.

Regarding irrigation, most projects are based on small and medium rivers, so there is an issue of insufficient water during the dry season. Long spell of drought has been impacting the country's agricultural production. It now seems urgent to make agriculture climate-resilient. In this connection, the ministry has already prepared the Tarai-Madhesh Drought Resilience Strategy.

With the participation of the Department of Water and Meteorology, Department of Water Resources and Irrigation, Department of Drinking Water and Sewerage Management, Nepal Electricity Authority, and Department of Electricity Development, the ministry has set up a 'Water-Energy Drought Monitoring' mechanism to publish monthly information from October to March.

The workshop offered a discussion on the possible impacts of El Niño on water, food, energy, and disaster resilience and measures for risk reduction. (RSS)

title: Nepal Telecom starts 4G service in Sinja, Jumla - The Rising Nepal
description: Nepal Telecom starts 4G service in Sinja, Jumla  The Rising Nepal
publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
By TRN Online, Kathmandu, Aug 21: The Nepal Telecom has started 4G service in Sinja of Jumla district.

The 4G service began today with the installing of a new tower at Guthijyula bazaar area in Kankasundari Rural Municipality.

Sinja is known as the place of origin of the Nepali (Khas) language, official language of the country.

The tower covers the area of 3, 4, 5, 6 and 8 wards of the Kankasundari RM and solar battery is used for operating the tower, according to Paras Pujara, chief of Nepal Telecom Jumla office.

The government has prioritized expansion of telecom services in remote and tourist areas. In line with that, 4G service is scheduled to be operated in Badimalika temple area of Bajura district within this week.

Nepal Telecom has said that a study is underway to expand 4G service in the base camp of Mt. Everest.

4G service have already been expanded to different places of high Himalayan area, such as the Lhan area of Tripura Sundari Municipality-6 and Dunai of Thulibheri Municipality-1 of Dolpa, located above 3900 meters from the sea level.

Similarly, Olanchungola of Taplejung, which is at an altitude of 3400 meters, also has the 4G service.

publisher.title: The Rising Nepal
full_article:
Kathmandu, Aug 21: National Assembly (NA) members have demanded action against the guilty, expressing sorrow over murder of a three-year-old Garima Chaudhary of Jitpur Simara sub-metropolis-1 after rape.

Speaking in zero hour of the meeting of the upper house of the Federal Parliament today, they stressed that violence against children and women should be controlled, children's safety should be ensured and government and security bodies should be serious towards such incidents.

Puja Chaudhary asked the government to stop violence against children and women and ensure girl's safety, demanding action against those involved in rape and murder of Garima.

Saying the security bodies were not serious towards the incident of missing of the child, Renu Chand drew the attention of the government and security bodies and demanded stern action against the guilty.

Similarly, Manrupa Sharma demanded the government to repatriate the body of Narayan Sarki of Parbat, who died in Dubai in course of foreign employment, to Nepal immediately and provide compensation to family.

Likewise, Rukmini Koirala suggested the government to carryout activities in order to provide appropriate price to farmers for their agro produces, ensure security to women and employment to youths.

Drawing the attention of the government towards losses caused by flood and landslide in Rolpa and Bajura, Krishna Bahadur Rokaya asked the government to make arrangement of relief to victim families by evaluating damages.

Ghana Shyam Rijal drew the government's attention towards peaceful protest and agitation launched by Dipa Nepali with slogan ' Government, is the room empty' and suggested to resolve problems through talks.

Similarly, Padam Bahadur Pariyar demanded the government to fully implement the agreement signed with family of Ganesh Nepali, who died in course of treatment after self-immolation attempt at Department of Passport, and declare Ganesh as martyr.

Bishnu Kumari Sapkota asked the government to immediately provide relief to families displace by landslide at Thabang of Rolpa and stern action against guilty of rape and murder case of Garima.

Expressing dissatisfaction towards increasing number of staffs at personal secretariat of ministers, Bishnu Bahadur Bishwokarma demanded to cut the number. (RSS)

title: From Crisis Management to Growth: Nepal’s Economic Reform Agenda Enters a New Phase - Devdiscourse
description: From Crisis Management to Growth: Nepal’s Economic Reform Agenda Enters a New Phase  Devdiscourse
publisher.title: Devdiscourse
full_article:
Nepal has spent the past four years strengthening its economy while crises kept arriving, and it has now completed its first IMF-supported programme in nearly two decades. A major earthquake, severe floods, political transitions, social unrest and higher energy prices repeatedly disrupted the recovery, yet inflation fell sharply, foreign-exchange reserves increased and fiscal pressures eased.

However, the significance of the milestone lies less in completing the programme than in what Nepal does next. Macroeconomic stability has restored important buffers, but the harder challenge is turning those gains into private investment, productive employment and improvements in living standards that households can actually feel.

Nepal Built Its Recovery While the Shocks Kept Coming

Average inflation declined from 7.7 percent in fiscal year 2022-23 to 1.7 percent in the first half of fiscal year 2025-26, while international reserves rose from around nine months of import cover to more than twelve months. Public finances also strengthened as the budget gap narrowed and debt remained manageable.

These are more than technical improvements. Lower inflation helps protect household purchasing power, stronger reserves reduce vulnerability to external and currency pressures, and healthier public finances give the government greater capacity to respond when another crisis emerges. For a country repeatedly exposed to domestic and external shocks, that additional policy space has strategic value.

What makes the stabilisation more notable is the environment in which it occurred. Nepal faced a major earthquake in 2023, severe floods in 2024, subsequent social unrest and more recently the impact of higher energy prices linked to the war in the Middle East. Each disruption interrupted the recovery and, taken together, weighed on employment creation.

Nepal's experience carries a broader lesson about economic resilience. Governments cannot predict the timing of the next earthquake, flood, political disruption or global commodity shock, but they can determine how much institutional and financial room they have when those events occur. Buffers built during calmer periods can decide whether a shock becomes manageable disruption or a deeper economic crisis.

The Most Important Reforms Are the Ones Few People See

Some of the changes likely to shape Nepal's economic trajectory received far less attention than falling inflation or rising reserves. The country modernised the way its central bank conducts monetary policy, strengthened bank supervision and reviewed loan quality across the financial sector, reinforcing mechanisms designed to identify vulnerabilities before they become systemic problems.

Fiscal management also became more transparent. Financial statements of state-owned enterprises were published, a strategy for mobilising government revenue was developed and systems for planning and managing public investment were strengthened. Governance reforms included improvements to anti-money-laundering legislation and moves to reinforce the central bank's legal framework and accountability.

These institutional changes matter because macroeconomic policy is only as credible as the machinery implementing it. Better banking supervision can reveal weaknesses earlier, improved public-investment systems can reduce the risk of scarce funds being poorly allocated, and greater fiscal transparency can make economic decision-making more accountable.

Their durability, however, will be tested after programme completion. Institutional reforms rarely succeed simply because new rules or frameworks have been adopted; they depend on continued enforcement, administrative capacity and political commitment.

Stability Is Not Yet the Same Thing as Economic Opportunity

The key weakness in Nepal's economic story is now easier to see precisely because the immediate stability problem has receded. The country still needs substantially stronger private investment and more employment if improved macroeconomic conditions are to translate into better economic outcomes for ordinary people.

Stable prices, larger foreign-exchange reserves and stronger public finances create the conditions in which businesses can invest and households can plan with greater confidence, but they do not automatically generate factories, enterprises, jobs or higher incomes. Macroeconomic stability is an enabling condition for growth, not a substitute for it.

The financial system also contains vulnerabilities that could complicate the next phase. Savings and credit cooperatives, which serve large numbers of people, remain an area requiring attention, while deeper governance reforms are still under way. Authorities have also begun an IMF Governance and Corruption Diagnostic as part of efforts to address institutional weaknesses and rebuild public trust.

This is where Nepal's economic debate is likely to become more demanding. Households ultimately experience an economy through wages, jobs, prices and access to opportunity rather than reserve ratios or fiscal balances. If employment creation remains weak, macroeconomic success may feel distant even when national indicators continue to improve.

The Real Measure of Success Starts After the Programme

Completing the IMF-supported arrangement closes one phase of Nepal's reform process but opens another. Priorities now include strengthening the financial sector, improving social protection and creating conditions for stronger and more inclusive growth while preserving the fiscal and external buffers that have been rebuilt.

Private investment will be one of the most important indicators to watch. If businesses respond to greater stability by expanding investment and creating employment, the reforms could begin producing broader economic dividends. If investment remains subdued, Nepal could find itself in the less comfortable position of being more stable without becoming sufficiently more dynamic.

Financial-sector reform will be another test. Addressing weaknesses in savings and credit cooperatives, maintaining stronger banking supervision and ensuring that loan-quality assessments translate into effective action will matter for both financial stability and public confidence. Continued progress on governance and institutional accountability will be equally important.

Nepal must also preserve resilience against risks it cannot control. Its recent experience shows how quickly natural disasters, political uncertainty and global energy shocks can alter an economic trajectory. The buffers accumulated over the past four years make the country better placed to absorb such disruptions, but they do not eliminate the underlying exposure.

The harder task now is to turn that foundation into investment, jobs and higher living standards without allowing the reforms that produced it to lose momentum.

मुदा, एहि मीलक पाथरक महत्व कार्यक्रम पूरा करबा मे कम अछि, जखन कि नेपाल आगू की करैत अछि। स्थूल आर्थिक स्थिरता न॑ महत्वपूर्ण बफर क॑ बहाल करी देल॑ छै, लेकिन एकरा स॑ भी कठिन चुनौती छै कि वू लाभ क॑ निजी निवेश, उत्पादक रोजगार आरू जीवन स्तर म॑ सुधार म॑ बदललऽ जाय जेकरा घरऽ म॑ वास्तव म॑ महसूस होय सकै छै ।

नेपाल अपन रिकवरी के निर्माण केलक जखन कि झटका अबैत रहल

औसत महंगाई दर वित्तीय वर्ष 2022-23 मे 7.7 प्रतिशत स घटि कए वित्तीय वर्ष 2025-26 क पहिल छमाही मे 1.7 प्रतिशत भ गेल, जखन कि अंतरराष्ट्रीय भंडार आयात कवर क करीब नौ मास स बढ़ि कए बारह मास स बेसी भ गेल। बजट के अंतर कम भेला आ कर्ज प्रबंधनीय रहला स सार्वजनिक वित्त सेहो मजबूत भेल।

ई सब तकनीकी सुधार स बेसी अछि। कम महंगाई घरऽ के क्रय शक्ति के सुरक्षा म॑ मदद करै छै, मजबूत भंडार बाहरी आरू मुद्रा के दबाव के प्रति कमजोरी क॑ कम करै छै, आरू स्वस्थ सार्वजनिक वित्त सरकार क॑ जब॑ एगो आरू संकट पैदा होय छै त॑ ओकरा जवाब दै के अधिक क्षमता दै छै । बार-बार घरेलू आरू बाहरी झटका के सामना करै वाला देश लेली वू अतिरिक्त नीतिगत स्थान के सामरिक मूल्य छै ।

स्थिरीकरण क॑ जे चीज आरू उल्लेखनीय बनाबै छै, वू छै जे परिवेश म॑ ई घटित होय गेलऽ छै । नेपाल म॑ २०२३ म॑ एगो बड़ऽ भूकंप, २०२४ म॑ भयंकर बाढ़, एकरऽ बाद सामाजिक अशांति आरू हाल म॑ मध्य पूर्व म॑ युद्ध स॑ जुड़लऽ ऊर्जा केरऽ दाम बढ़ला के प्रभाव के सामना करना पड़लै । एक-एकटा व्यवधान रिकवरी कए बाधित करैत छल आ एकरा मिला कए रोजगार सृजन पर भारी पड़ैत छल ।

नेपाल के अनुभव आर्थिक लचीलापन के बारे में एकटा व्यापक पाठ ल क चलैत अछि. सरकार अगिला भूकंप, बाढ़ि, राजनीतिक व्यवधान या वैश्विक वस्तु के झटका के समय के भविष्यवाणी नै क सकैत अछि, मुदा ओ ई निर्धारित क सकैत अछि जे जखन ओ घटना घटित होयत तखन ओकरा पास कतेक संस्थागत आ वित्तीय गुंजाइश अछि. शांत अवधि मे बनल बफर इ तय कयर सकय छै की कोनों झटका प्रबंधनीय व्यवधान बनि जायत छै या गहरा आर्थिक संकट.

सबसँ महत्वपूर्ण सुधार ओ अछि जे कम लोक देखैत छथि

नेपाल के आर्थिक प्रक्षेपवक्र के आकार देबय के संभावना वाला किछ परिवर्तन पर महंगाई के गिरावट या बढ़ैत भंडार सं कहीं कम ध्यान देल गेल. देश न॑ अपनऽ केंद्रीय बैंक न॑ मौद्रिक नीति के संचालन के तरीका क॑ आधुनिक बनाबै के काम करलकै, बैंकऽ के पर्यवेक्षण क॑ मजबूत करलकै आरू पूरा वित्तीय क्षेत्र म॑ ऋण के गुणवत्ता के समीक्षा करलकै, जेकरा स॑ प्रणालीगत समस्या बनै स॑ पहल॑ कमजोरी के पहचान करै लेली डिजाइन करलऽ गेलऽ तंत्र क॑ मजबूत करलऽ गेलै ।

राजकोषीय प्रबंधन सेहो बेसी पारदर्शी भ गेल। सरकारी उद्यमक कें वित्तीय विवरण प्रकाशित कैल गेलय, सरकारी राजस्व कें जुटावय कें रणनीति तैयार कैल गेलय आ सार्वजनिक निवेश कें योजना आ प्रबंधन कें लेल प्रणाली मजबूत कैल गेलय. शासन सुधार म॑ मनी लांड्रिंग विरोधी कानून म॑ सुधार आरू केंद्रीय बैंक केरऽ कानूनी ढाँचा आरू जवाबदेही क॑ मजबूत करै के कदम शामिल छेलै ।

ई संस्थागत परिवर्तन मायने रखै छै, कैन्हेंकि मैक्रोइकोनॉमिक नीति केवल ओतने विश्वसनीय छै जेतना कि एकरा लागू करै वाला मशीनरी । बेहतर बैंकिंग पर्यवेक्षण सं कमजोरी कें खुलासा पहिले भ सकय छै, बेहतर सार्वजनिक-निवेश प्रणाली दुर्लभ धन कें खराब आवंटन कें जोखिम कें कम कयर सकय छै, आ बेसि राजकोषीय पारदर्शिता आर्थिक निर्णय लेवा कें बेसि जवाबदेह बना सकय छै.

मुदा, कार्यक्रम पूरा भेलाक बाद एकर स्थायित्व क परीक्षण कैल जाएत। संस्थागत सुधार शायदे कखनो सफल होइत अछि मात्र एहि लेल जे नव नियम वा ढाँचा अपनाओल गेल अछि ; ई सब निरंतर प्रवर्तन, प्रशासनिक क्षमता आ राजनीतिक प्रतिबद्धता पर निर्भर करैत अछि |

स्थिरता एखन धरि आर्थिक अवसरक समान नहि अछि

नेपालक आर्थिक कथाक प्रमुख कमजोरी आब ठीक एहि लेल देखब आसान भ’ गेल अछि जे तत्काल स्थिरताक समस्या हटि गेल अछि । देश क॑ अखनी भी काफी मजबूत निजी निवेश आरू अधिक रोजगार के जरूरत छै अगर बेहतर मैक्रोइकोनॉमिक परिस्थिति क॑ आम लोगऽ लेली बेहतर आर्थिक परिणाम म॑ बदलै के छै ।

स्थिर दाम, पैघ विदेशी मुद्रा भंडार आ मजबूत सार्वजनिक वित्त एहन परिस्थिति पैदा करैत अछि जाहि मे व्यवसाय निवेश क सकैत अछि आ घर बेसी विश्वास क संग योजना बना सकैत अछि, मुदा एहि स स्वतः कारखाना, उद्यम, रोजगार या बेसी आय नहि भेटैत अछि । स्थूल आर्थिक स्थिरता विकास कें लेल एकटा सक्षम बनावा वाला शर्त छै, ओकर विकल्प नहि.

वित्तीय प्रणाली मे एहन कमजोरी सेहो अछि जे अगिला चरण कए जटिल बना सकैत अछि। बचत आरू ऋण सहकारी, जे बड़ऽ संख्या म॑ लोगऽ के सेवा दै छै, एगो ऐसनऽ क्षेत्र बनलऽ छै जेकरा प॑ ध्यान देना जरूरी छै, जबकि शासन म॑ गहराई स॑ सुधार अखनी भी चलै छै । संस्थागत कमजोरी के दूर करै आरू जन विश्वास के पुनर्निर्माण के प्रयास के तहत अधिकारियौ नँ आईएमएफ गवर्नेंस आरू भ्रष्टाचार निदान भी शुरू करलकै ।

एहि ठाम नेपाल के आर्थिक बहस आओर मांग वाला बनय के संभावना अछि. घरक कें अंततः रिजर्व अनुपात या राजकोषीय संतुलन कें बजाय मजदूरी, नौकरी, मूल्य आ अवसर कें पहुंच कें माध्यम सं अर्थव्यवस्था कें अनुभव होयत छै. यदि रोजगार सृजन कमजोर रहत त राष्ट्रीय सूचकक मे सुधार जारी रहला पर सेहो स्थूल आर्थिक सफलता दूर महसूस भ सकैत अछि ।

सफलता के असली माप कार्यक्रम के बाद शुरू होइत अछि

आईएमएफ समर्थित व्यवस्था पूरा करला स नेपाल के सुधार प्रक्रिया के एक चरण बंद भ जायत अछि मुदा दोसर चरण खुलैत अछि। अब॑ प्राथमिकता म॑ वित्तीय क्षेत्र क॑ मजबूत करना, सामाजिक सुरक्षा म॑ सुधार आरू मजबूत आरू अधिक समावेशी विकास केरऽ परिस्थिति पैदा करना शामिल छै आरू साथ ही साथ राजकोषीय आरू बाहरी बफर क॑ संरक्षित करना जे पुनर्निर्माण करलऽ गेलऽ छै ।

निजी निवेश देखबा लेल सबस महत्वपूर्ण सूचक मे स एक होएत। अगर व्यवसाय निवेश के विस्तार आरू रोजगार पैदा करी क॑ अधिक स्थिरता के जवाब दै छै त॑ सुधार स॑ व्यापक आर्थिक लाभांश पैदा करना शुरू होय सकै छै । यदि निवेश दबंग बनल रहत त नेपाल पर्याप्त गतिशीलता के बिना बेसी स्थिर रहबाक कम आरामदायक स्थिति मे पाबि सकैत अछि।

वित्तीय क्षेत्र मे सुधार एकटा आओर परीक्षा होएत। बचत आ ऋण सहकारी समितियक मे कमजोरी कें दूर करनाय, मजबूत बैंकिंग पर्यवेक्षण कें बनाए रखनाय आ इ सुनिश्चित करनाय की ऋण-गुणवत्ता आकलन प्रभावी कार्यवाही मे बदलय, वित्तीय स्थिरता आ जन विश्वास दूनू कें लेल महत्वपूर्ण होयत. शासन आ संस्थागत जवाबदेही पर निरंतर प्रगति ओतबे महत्वपूर्ण होयत।

नेपाल के सेहो ओहि जोखिम के खिलाफ लचीलापन के संरक्षण करय पड़त जेकरा ओ नियंत्रित नहि क सकैत अछि. एकरऽ हाल के अनुभव स॑ पता चलै छै कि प्राकृतिक आपदा, राजनीतिक अनिश्चितता आरू वैश्विक ऊर्जा के झटका एगो आर्थिक प्रक्षेपवक्र म॑ कतनी जल्दी बदलाव करी सकै छै । पिछला चारि साल मे जमा बफर देश कए एहन व्यवधान कए आत्मसात करबा लेल बेहतर स्थिति मे बना दैत अछि, मुदा एहि स अंतर्निहित एक्सपोजर कए खत्म नहि भ सकैत अछि।

आब कठिन काज अछि जे ओहि नींव कए निवेश, रोजगार आ उच्च जीवन स्तर मे बदलब, बिना एकरा पैदा करय वाला सुधार कए गति नहि गमा देब।

title: 500 documents vanished from the foreign ministry. Nepal never followed the trail - The Kathmandu Post
description: 500 documents vanished from the foreign ministry. Nepal never followed the trail  The Kathmandu Post
publisher.title: The Kathmandu Post
full_article:
Fifteen years after 500 blank travel documents disappeared from the Foreign Ministry’s store section, a chargesheet filed at the Kathmandu District Court has forced investigators to reopen a case they had left unresolved.

Last month, the District Attorney’s Office in Kathmandu filed a case against Pushpa Raj Bhattarai, a joint secretary at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, over the illegal issuance of travel documents to five Tibetan refugees back in 2009. The case followed a years-long investigation by the Central Bureau of Investigation (CIB), which the foreign ministry had asked to look into the matter in October 2011 — after a German Embassy official flagged, in 2010, that recently arrived Tibetan refugees appeared to be travelling on Nepali travel documents they should not have been able to obtain.

But buried inside Bhattarai’s chargesheet is a second, larger story: three of the five travel documents in question — bearing serial numbers A-026225, A-026226 and A-026227 — belong to a batch of 500 travel documents, numbered A-026001 to A-026500, that went missing from the Store Section in 2009 and were never accounted for. The other 497 have never been traced.

AIG Uma Prasad Chaturvedi, chief of the CIB, confirmed that a supplementary investigation into the remaining documents has now begun.

“The CIB has begun a supplementary investigation into who was involved in the other travel documents that went missing from the ministry at the time and where the misuse took place,” Chaturvedi told Kantipur. “The remaining matters will become clear only after the investigation.”

The missing documents first surfaced during an unrelated investigation in January 2010, when the CIB arrested Bachchuram KC, a non-gazetted officer in the Passport Section, for helping 30 foreign nationals — including five Afghans — obtain Nepali passports using forged documents. KC disclosed information about a wider network, and it was in the course of that inquiry that investigators discovered 500 travel documents had left the Store Section without ever reaching their stated destination.

According to a former joint secretary at the ministry who recalled the case, storekeeper Anil Lamsal released 250 documents intended for Nepal’s mission in Cairo and another 250 for its mission in Bangkok; KC received them for dispatch. But an internal check found that neither mission had actually requested the documents.

“How did the Cairo mission, the Passport Section and the Store Section fail to match up? A recommendation from the Ministry of Home Affairs is mandatory for issuing travel documents to refugees,” the former joint secretary told Kantipur. “Why was that requirement not considered necessary in this case? Why were documents that had not been requested released? These questions never became part of the investigation.”

KC told investigators that people in Nepal and India were involved in obtaining Nepali citizenship certificates for foreign nationals — for as much as $5,000 each — which were then used to secure Nepali passports. Despite being at the centre of the case, KC was never chargesheeted. He was transferred to the National Planning Commission and died on August 21, 2019.

A police officer involved in the original investigation, now an SSP, said the missing documents never got the scrutiny they warranted. “The investigation that should have taken place did not happen for reasons I am not aware of,” the officer told Kantipur, speaking on condition of anonymity.

An investigating officer from that period was more blunt about the outcome. “The documents never reached, or were never taken to, the two missions,” he said. “It has become mysterious as to why no investigation was carried out.” He believes the people responsible could still be identified if an impartial investigation were conducted now.

The CIB’s questioning of Bhattarai, along with two other former Passport Section officials — Ram Prasad Subedi and Anil Lamsal — is what eventually reconnected the two episodes. All three now hold senior diplomatic postings: Subedi is Nepal’s permanent representative to the United Nations in Geneva; Lamsal is first secretary at the Embassy of Nepal in Vienna.

In his statement to the CIB, recorded in the chargesheet, Subedi said he verified applicants and signed off on travel documents and passports that had come through proper channels, and denied any knowledge that KC had received 500 documents from the Store Section. “I had no knowledge that KC had received 500 travel documents from the Store Section and misused them,” he said.

Lamsal similarly denied involvement. “Travel documents released from the store section were entered in the register there and then sent to the dispatch section... to be forwarded to the concerned missions and embassies,” he told investigators. “I do not know where those travel documents went or where they were delivered afterwards.”

Surendra Thapa, now acting ambassador to India, told investigators he had occasionally signed and issued passports and travel documents in the Passport Section when Subedi was on leave or workload was high, but said he had no knowledge of the missing batch. Thapa was transferred to the ministry’s contact office in Birgunj on February 1, 2010.

Lok Bahadur Paudel Chhetri, spokesperson for the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, said the ministry’s hands are tied while the case is before the court. “The issue is very old, and since a related issue is sub judice, there is no particular information I can provide at this time,” he told Kantipur. “The concerned section must have looked into it as well; beyond that, I cannot say anything.”

The vulnerability the missing documents exposed was not new. A year earlier, in August 2008, two passengers were stopped at Tribhuvan International Airport before boarding a Gulf Air flight to Bahrain, en route to the United States on valid-looking US visas.

Their Nepali passports had been issued based on citizenship certificates that, on closer inspection, did not hold up. The two told immigration officials they were siblings travelling to meet their parents in Boston, and both named Dal Bahadur Lama as their father. But investigators found that Shekhar Kumar Adhikari, whose signature appeared on the citizenship certificates as the issuing officer, had never worked at the Kathmandu District Administration Office where the certificates were purportedly issued. The certificates were also dated November 9, 2007 — a public holiday for Tihar.

The Ministry of Foreign Affairs confirmed the passports themselves were genuine, issued on January 22, 2008. The two individuals were prosecuted for forging government seals and signatures, and subsequently released on a Rs 9,000 bail. The trail stopped there. No one established where they went afterwards, who Dal Bahadur Lama was, or who had produced certificates that did not exist in government records but were nonetheless accepted as the basis for real passports.

Taken together with the 500 missing documents a year later, the case illustrates a recurring gap: Nepal’s passport-issuing system has repeatedly been shown capable of accepting fraudulent underlying documents without an agency ever establishing where those documents came from — and, in at least one case, without ever fully investigating where the resulting passports and travel documents went.

It is unclear how long the CIB’s supplementary investigation to look into the missing travel documents will take. “The remaining matters will become clear only after the investigation,” CIB chief Chaturvedi said.

विदेश मंत्रालय केरऽ स्टोर सेक्शन स॑ ५०० खाली यात्रा दस्तावेज गायब होय के पन्द्रह साल बाद काठमांडू जिला न्यायालय म॑ दायर आरोपपत्र के कारण जांचकर्ता सिनी क॑ एगो मामला क॑ दोबारा खोलै ल॑ मजबूर होय गेलऽ छै जेकरा वू अनसुलझा छोड़ी देल॑ छेलै ।

पिछला मास काठमांडू स्थित जिला अटार्नी कार्यालय विदेश मंत्रालय के संयुक्त सचिव पुष्पराज भट्टराई के खिलाफ 2009 मे वापस पांच तिब्बती शरणार्थी के यात्रा दस्तावेज अवैध रूप सं जारी करय के मामला मे मामला दर्ज करौने छल २०११ — जर्मनी दूतावास केरऽ एगो अधिकारी न॑ झंडा देखाबै के बाद, २०१० म॑, कि हाल ही म॑ ऐलऽ तिब्बती शरणार्थी नेपाली यात्रा दस्तावेज प॑ यात्रा करी रहलऽ नजर आबी रहलऽ छै जेकरा प्राप्त नै करलऽ जाय के चाहियऽ छेलै ।

लेकिन भट्टराई केरऽ चार्जशीट के भीतर दफन एगो दोसरऽ, बड़ऽ कहानी छै: सवाल केरऽ पाँच यात्रा दस्तावेजऽ म॑ स॑ तीन — जेकरऽ सीरियल नंबर ए-०२६२२५, ए-०२६२२६ आरू ए-०२६२२७ छै — ५०० यात्रा दस्तावेजऽ के बैच के छै, जेकरऽ नंबर ए-०२६००१ स॑ ए-०२६५०० तक छै, जे स्टोर सेक्शन स॑ ८ 2009 मे भेल आ कहियो हिसाब नहि देल गेल। बाकी 497 क पता कहियो नहि लागल अछि।

सीआईबी के प्रमुख एआईजी उमा प्रसाद चतुर्वेदी एहि बात के पुष्टि केलनि जे आब शेष दस्तावेज के पूरक जांच शुरू भ गेल अछि.

चतुर्वेदी कान्तिपुर केँ कहलनि जे, सीआईबी एहि बातक पूरक जांच शुरू क’ देलक अछि जे ओहि समय मंत्रालय सँ गायब भेल अन्य यात्रा दस्तावेज मे केकरा शामिल छल आ दुरुपयोग कतय भेल छल। “बाँचल मामला जांचक बाद मात्र स्पष्ट भ’ जायत।”

ई लापता दस्तावेज सबस॑ पहलऽ जनवरी २०१० म॑ असंबंधित जांच के दौरान सामने ऐलै, जब॑ सीआईबी न॑ पासपोर्ट अनुभाग केरऽ गैर-राजपत्रित अधिकारी बच्चूराम केसी क॑ गिरफ्तार करी लेलकै, कैन्हेंकि हुनी ३० विदेशी नागरिकऽ क॑ — जेकरा म॑ पाँच अफगान भी शामिल छै — जाली दस्तावेजऽ के इस्तेमाल करी क॑ नेपाली पासपोर्ट प्राप्त करै म॑ मदद करलकै । केसी न॑ एगो व्यापक नेटवर्क के बारे म॑ जानकारी के खुलासा करलकै, आरू वू जांच के दौरान ही जांचकर्ता सिनी क॑ पता चललै कि ५०० यात्रा दस्तावेज स्टोर सेक्शन स॑ बाहर निकली गेलऽ छेलै, बिना कहियो अपनऽ निर्धारित गंतव्य प॑ पहुँचलऽ ।

मंत्रालय केरऽ एगो पूर्व संयुक्त सचिव जे ई मामला क॑ याद करलकै, के अनुसार स्टोरकीपर अनिल लमसल न॑ काहिरा म॑ नेपाल केरऽ मिशन लेली २५० आरू बैंकॉक म॑ अपनऽ मिशन लेली २५० आरू दस्तावेज जारी करलकै; केसी डिस्पैच के लेल प्राप्त केलक। लेकिन आंतरिक जांच म॑ पता चललै कि वास्तव म॑ दोनों म॑ स॑ कोय भी मिशन न॑ दस्तावेज के आग्रह नै करलकै ।

पूर्व संयुक्त सचिव कान्तिपुर कए कहला जे काहिरा मिशन, पासपोर्ट सेक्शन आ स्टोर सेक्शन क मिलान कोना नहि भ सकल, शरणार्थी कए यात्रा दस्तावेज जारी करबा लेल गृह मंत्रालय क सिफारिश अनिवार्य अछि। “एहि मामला मे ओ आवश्यकता जरूरी किएक नहि मानल गेल? जे दस्तावेज क अनुरोध नहि कैल गेल छल ओकरा जारी किया कैल गेल, इ सवाल कहियो जांच क हिस्सा नहि बनल।”

केसी जांचकर्ता सब के कहलनि जे, नेपाल आ भारत के लोक विदेशी नागरिक के लेल नेपाली नागरिकता प्रमाणपत्र प्राप्त करय में लागल छलाह — प्रत्येक के 5000 डॉलर तक — जेकर उपयोग तखन नेपाली पासपोर्ट सुरक्षित करय में कयल गेल छल. मामला क केंद्र मे रहला क बावजूद केसी पर कहियो आरोप पत्र नहि लगाउल गेल। राष्ट्रीय योजना आयोग मे स्थानांतरित भ गेलाह आ 21 अगस्त 2019 कए हुनकर निधन भ गेल।

मूल जांच मे शामिल एकटा पुलिस अधिकारी जे आब एसएसपी भ गेल छथि, कहला जे गायब दस्तावेज कए कहियो ओ जांच नहि भेटल जेकर जरूरत छल। अधिकारी अपन नाम नहि बताबय के शर्त पर कान्तिपुर के कहलनि जे, जे जांच होबाक चाही छल ओ एहन कारण सं नहि भेल जेकर जानकारी हमरा नहि अछि।

ओहि कालखंडक एकटा जांच अधिकारी परिणामक बारे मे बेसी बेबाक छल। ओ कहलनि जे, दस्तावेज कहियो दुनू मिशन तक नहि पहुंचल, या कहियो नहि लेल गेल। “ई रहस्यमयी भ गेल अछि जे कोनो जांच किएक नहि भेल।” हुनकऽ मानना ​​छै कि अगर अब॑ निष्पक्ष जांच करलऽ जाय त॑ भी जिम्मेदार लोगऽ के पहचान करलऽ जाब॑ सकै छै ।

पासपोर्ट अनुभाग केरऽ दू अन्य पूर्व अधिकारी — रामप्रसाद सुबेदी आरू अनिल लमसल — के साथ भट्टराई प॑ सीआईबी केरऽ पूछताछ ही अंततः ई दूनू एपिसोड क॑ फेर स॑ जोड़लकै । आब तीनू गोटे वरिष्ठ कूटनीतिक पद पर छथि : सुबेदी जेनेवामें संयुक्त राष्ट्रमें नेपालक स्थायी प्रतिनिधि छथि ; लमसल वियना स्थित नेपालक दूतावासमे प्रथम सचिव छथि ।

चार्जशीट मे दर्ज सीआईबी कए देल गेल बयान मे सुबेदी कहला जे ओ आवेदक कए सत्यापन केलथि आ उचित चैनल स आयल यात्रा दस्तावेज आ पासपोर्ट पर हस्ताक्षर केलथि, आ कोनो जानकारी स इनकार केलथि जे केसी कए स्टोर सेक्शन स 500 दस्तावेज भेटल अछि। ओ कहला जे हमरा कोनो जानकारी नहि छल जे केसी कए स्टोर सेक्शन स 500 ट्रैवल डॉक्यूमेंट भेटल अछि आ ओकर गलत उपयोग भेल अछि।

लमसल सेहो एहिना एहि मे शामिल हेबा स इनकार केलथि। ओ जांचकर्ता स कहला जे स्टोर सेक्शन स जारी यात्रा क दस्तावेज ओतय रजिस्टर मे दर्ज कैल गेल आ फेर डिस्पैच सेक्शन मे पठा देल गेल... ताकि संबंधित मिशन आ दूतावास कए पठाउल जा सकए। “हमरा नहि बुझल अछि जे ओ यात्राक दस्तावेज कतय गेल आ ओकर बाद कतय पहुँचाओल गेल।”

आब भारत मे कार्यवाहक राजदूत सुरेन्द्र थापा जांचकर्ता सब के कहलनि जे, सुबेदी छुट्टी पर रहला पर या काजक बोझ बेसी रहला पर पासपोर्ट सेक्शन मे पासपोर्ट आ यात्रा दस्तावेज पर यदा-कदा हस्ताक्षर क जारी करैत छल, मुदा लापता बैच के बारे मे हुनका कोनो जानकारी नहि छल। थापा के स्थानांतरण 1 फरवरी 2010 के वीरगंज स्थित मन्त्रालय के सम्पर्क कार्यालय मे भेल छल ।

विदेश मंत्रालय के प्रवक्ता लोक बहादुर पौडेल क्षेत्री के कहनाय छनि जे जखन कि मामला अदालत मे अछि तखन मंत्रालय के हाथ बान्हल अछि. ओ कान्तिपुर कए कहला जे इ मुद्दा बहुत पुरान अछि, आ चूँकि एहि स संबंधित एकटा मुद्दा सब ज्यूडिस अछि, एहि लेल हम एहि समय कोनो विशेष जानकारी नहि द सकैत छी। “संबंधित खंड सेहो एहि मे देखलक हेतैक, ताहि सँ आगू हम किछु नहि कहि सकैत छी।”

गायब दस्तावेज जे कमजोरी कए उजागर केलक ओ कोनो नव नहि छल। एक साल पहिने अगस्त २००८ म॑ वैध दिखै वाला अमेरिकी वीजा प॑ अमेरिका जाय के रास्ता म॑ बहरीन लेली गल्फ एयर केरऽ फ्लाइट म॑ चढ़ै स॑ पहल॑ दू यात्री क॑ त्रिभुवन अंतर्राष्ट्रीय हवाई अड्डा प॑ रोकलऽ गेलऽ छेलै ।

हुनका लोकनिक नेपाली पासपोर्ट नागरिकता प्रमाणपत्रक आधार पर जारी कयल गेल छल जे करीब सँ देखला पर टिकल नहि छल । दुनू गोटे आप्रवासन अधिकारी सब के कहलनि जे ओ सब भाई-बहिन छथि जे बोस्टन में अपन माता-पिता सं भेंट करय लेल यात्रा क रहल छथि, आ दुनू गोटे अपन पिता के रूप में दल बहादुर लामा के नाम लेलनि. लेकिन जांचकर्ता सब के कहनाय छनि जे नागरिकता प्रमाणपत्र पर जारी करय वाला अधिकारी के रूप मे हुनकर हस्ताक्षर शेखर कुमार अधिकारी काठमांडू जिल्ला प्रशासन कार्यालय मे कहियो काज नहि केने छलाह जतय कथित तौर पर प्रमाणपत्र जारी भेल छल. प्रमाणपत्र 9 नवम्बर 2007 के सेहो छल — तिहार के लेल सार्वजनिक छुट्टी ।

विदेश मंत्रालय न॑ खुद पासपोर्ट के असली होय के पुष्टि करलकै, जे 22 जनवरी, 2008 क॑ जारी करलऽ गेलऽ छेलै ।दुनू व्यक्ति प॑ सरकारी मुहर आरू हस्ताक्षर जालसाजी के मामला म॑ मुकदमा चललै, आरू बाद म॑ ९,००० रुपया के जमानत प॑ रिहा करी देलऽ गेलै । पगडंडी ओतहि रुकि गेल। तकर बाद कियो ई स्थापित नहि केलक जे ओ सभ कतय गेलाह, दल बहादुर लामा के छलाह, वा के एहन प्रमाणपत्र पेश केने छलाह जे सरकारी रिकार्ड मे नहि छल मुदा तइयो असली पासपोर्टक आधार मानल गेल छल.

एक साल बाद 500 गायब दस्तावेज के साथ मिल क देखल जाय त ई मामला एकटा आवर्ती अंतर के दर्शाबैत अछि : नेपाल के पासपोर्ट जारी करय वाला प्रणाली के बेर-बेर धोखाधड़ी के अंतर्निहित दस्तावेज स्वीकार करय में सक्षम देखाओल गेल अछि बिना कोनो एजेंसी के ई स्थापित केने जे ओ दस्तावेज कतय सं आयल छल — आ, कम सं कम एकटा मामला में, बिना कहियो पूरा जांच केने जे परिणामस्वरूप पासपोर्ट आ यात्रा दस्तावेज कतय गेल.

ई साफ नै छै कि सीआईबी केरऽ पूरक जांच म॑ लापता यात्रा दस्तावेज केरऽ जांच म॑ कतेक समय लगतै । सीआईबी प्रमुख चतुर्वेदी कहलनि जे, बाकी मामला जांच के बाद साफ भ जायत।

full_article:
Sobita Gautam

Kathmandu, August 21

A bill seeking to revive the provision placing Nepal’s intelligence agency under the prime minister’s office has moved forward in the National Assembly after being passed by the House of Representatives.

Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Minister Sobita Gautam, on behalf of Prime Minister Balendra Shah, presented the Bill to Revive the Existing Provision of the Nepal Special Service Act, 1985 at the National Assembly meeting on Friday.

The bill was subjected to a theoretical discussion in the National Assembly, with lawmakers questioning why the intelligence agency, currently under the Ministry of Home Affairs, should be brought under the prime minister.

Responding to the lawmakers, Minister Gautam said the provision placing the intelligence agency under the Office of the Prime Minister and Council of Ministers had been introduced through the Some Nepal Acts Amendment Act 2019.

She said the intelligence agency had been under the prime minister’s office at that time but was brought under the Ministry of Home Affairs during the government led by former chief justice Sushila Karki following the Gen Z movement.

Gautam said the government had introduced the latest bill because a replacement bill was not brought after the election and the provision amended through an ordinance had subsequently become inactive.

Asked why the intelligence agency had been moved between the Home Ministry and the Prime Minister’s Office at different times, Gautam said the issue was essentially a matter of principle.

“Previous governments also kept moving it from one place to another,” she said.

She said the government currently believes that it is appropriate for an intelligence agency dealing with national security to remain under the Prime Minister’s Office.

According to Gautam, the Ministry of Home Affairs is already heavily burdened with responsibility for the country’s internal security mechanisms, including disaster management, chief district officers, Nepal Police and Armed Police Force.

“The Home Ministry is already overloaded. It has to deal with all aspects of the internal security mechanism, from disasters and chief district officers to Nepal Police and Armed Police,” she said.

Gautam said the intelligence agency needs to provide regular information and intelligence to the government, while the home minister is already occupied with numerous responsibilities.

She argued that intelligence information related to regular law and order and national security should be directly available to the prime minister, who is the head of government.

“The Home Ministry is extremely overloaded, while intelligence goes beyond the regular internal security and law-and-order responsibilities. We are bringing the agency under the Prime Minister’s Office so that intelligence information can be directly delivered to the prime minister,” she said.

Gautam said it would be appropriate for the prime minister, as head of government, to receive such information directly.

Following the minister’s response, the National Assembly approved a proposal to consider the bill.

Lawmakers can now register amendment proposals on the bill within 72 hours.

सोबिता गौतम

काठमांडू, २१ अगस्ट

नेपालके खुफिया एजेन्सीके प्रधानमन्त्री कार्यालयके अन्तर्गत राखयके प्रावधानके पुनरुत्थान करऽ चाहैबला विधेयक प्रतिनिधि सभाद्वारा पारित भेलाक बाद राष्ट्रिय सभामे आगा बढल अछि ।

शुक्रदिन राष्ट्रिय सभाक बैसारमे प्रधानमन्त्री बलेन्द्र शाहके तरफसँ कानून, न्याय आ संसदीय मामिला मन्त्री सोबिता गौतम नेपाल विशेष सेवा अधिनियम, १९८५ के विद्यमान प्रावधान के पुनरुत्थान करबाक विधेयक प्रस्तुत केलनि ।

राष्ट्रीय सभा मे एहि विधेयक पर सैद्धांतिक चर्चा भेल, जाहि मे विधायक सब सवाल उठेलथि जे वर्तमान मे गृह मंत्रालय क अधीन रहल खुफिया एजेंसी कए प्रधानमंत्री क अधीन किया आनल जाए।

विधायकसबके प्रतिक्रिया दैत मन्त्री गौतम खुफिया एजेन्सीके प्रधानमन्त्री तथा मन्त्रीपरिषद्के कार्यालय अन्तर्गत राखयके प्रावधान किछु नेपाल अधिनियम संशोधन अधिनियम २०१९के माध्यमसँ आनल गेल बतौलनि ।

ओ कहली जे ओहि समय खुफिया एजेंसी प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय क तहत छल मुदा जेन जेड आंदोलन क बाद पूर्व मुख्य न्यायाधीश सुशीला कार्की क नेतृत्व मे सरकार क दौरान गृह मंत्रालय क तहत आनल गेल।

गौतम कहलनि जे, सरकार नवीनतम विधेयक एहि लेल पेश केलक अछि जे चुनावक बाद प्रतिस्थापन विधेयक नहि आनल गेल आ बाद मे अध्यादेशक माध्यम सं संशोधित प्रावधान निष्क्रिय भ गेल अछि।

गृह मंत्रालय आरू प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय के बीच अलग-अलग समय प खुफिया एजेंसी क स्थानांतरित कियैक करलौ गेलौ छै, ई पूछला प गौतम नँ कहलकै कि ई मुद्दा अनिवार्य रूप स॑ सिद्धांत के बात छै ।

ओ कहलीह जे पिछला सरकार सेहो एकरा एक ठाम स दोसर ठाम ल जाइत रहल।

ओ कहलनि जे, सरकार के एखन मानब अछि जे राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा सं जुड़ल खुफिया एजेंसी के प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय के तहत रहब उचित अछि.

गौतम के अनुसार गृह मंत्रालय पर पहिने सं देश के आतंरिक सुरक्षा तंत्र के जिम्मेदारी भारी बोझ अछि, जाहि मे आपदा प्रबंधन, मुख्य जिला अधिकारी, नेपाल प्रहरी आ सशस्त्र प्रहरी बल शामिल अछि.

ओ कहलीह जे गृह मंत्रालय पहिने स ओवरलोड अछि, ओकरा आपदा आ मुख्य जिल्ला अधिकारी स ल कए नेपाल पुलिस आ सशस्त्र पुलिस तक आतंरिक सुरक्षा तंत्र क सब पक्ष स निपटय पड़ैत अछि।

गौतम कहलनि जे, खुफिया एजेंसी के सरकार के नियमित जानकारी आ खुफिया जानकारी देबय के जरूरत अछि, जखन कि गृहमंत्री पहिने सं अनेक जिम्मेदारी सं व्यस्त छथि।

हुनकऽ तर्क छेलै कि नियमित कानून व्यवस्था आरू राष्ट्रीय सुरक्षा स॑ जुड़लऽ खुफिया जानकारी सीधा प्रधानमंत्री क॑ उपलब्ध होना चाहियऽ, जे सरकार केरऽ प्रमुख छै ।

ओ कहली जे गृह मंत्रालय बेहद ओवरलोड अछि, जखन कि खुफिया जानकारी नियमित आतंरिक सुरक्षा आ कानून व्यवस्था क जिम्मेदारी स आगू बढ़ि जाइत अछि, हम एजेंसी कए प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय क तहत आनि रहल छी ताकि खुफिया जानकारी सीधा प्रधानमंत्री तक पहुंचा सकए।

गौतम कहलनि जे, प्रधानमंत्री के सरकार प्रमुख के रूप मे एहि तरहक जानकारी सीधा भेटब उचित होयत।

मंत्री के प्रतिक्रिया के बाद राष्ट्रीय सभा एहि विधेयक पर विचार करय के प्रस्ताव के मंजूरी द देलक.

आब विधायक 72 घंटा क भीतर एहि विधेयक पर संशोधन प्रस्ताव दर्ज करा सकैत छथि।
